strings.name: Henry Kravis
strings.summary: Kravis co-founded KKR with Jerome Kohlberg and George Roberts, developing leveraged buyouts into a large institutional investment business. He participated in landmark deals including RJR Nabisco. His career reflects private equity’s use of debt and restructuring to pursue returns, alongside debates about leverage, employment and governance. After relinquishing the co-CEO role in 2021, he remained co-executive chairman.
